2609.01353.title: SymFold: Synergizing Evolutionary and Structural Priors for Accurate Protein Inverse Folding
2609.01353.paper_summary: Protein inverse folding aims to recover amino acid sequences for a given 3D protein structure, underpinning broad applications such as enzyme engineering and drug discovery.Current methods often follow a serial pipeline, in which a structure encoder predicts a coarse sequence, which is then refined by protein language models (PLMs). However, because PLMs only perform post-hoc sequence edits, the refinement is bounded by the quality of upstream predictions.Thanks to recent multimodal protein language models (MPLMs), we could directly encode structure to generate sequences with pretrained structural knowledge, but we observe that they are not effective for inverse folding. Therefore, we introduce a symmetric dual-path architecture that both leverages PLMs for pretrained sequence evolution knowledge and MPLMs for pretrained structural knowledge to iteratively guide protein sequence generation.Through extensive experiments across standard protein inverse folding benchmarks, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing prior approaches, and ablation studies validate the rationale of our symmetric design, revealing a promising direction for the community.
2609.01353.paper_summary_zh: 蛋白質反向摺疊旨在為給定的三維蛋白質結構恢復氨基酸序列，這為酶工程和藥物發現等廣泛應用奠定了基礎。當前的方法通常遵循串行流程，其中結構編碼器預測粗略序列，然後由蛋白質語言模型（PLMs）進行精煉。然而，由於PLMs僅執行事後序列編輯，因此精煉受到上游預測質量的限制。得益於最近的多模態蛋白質語言模型（MPLMs），我們可以直接編碼結構以生成具有預訓練結構知識的序列，但我們觀察到它們在反向摺疊方面並不有效。因此，我們引入了一種對稱雙通路架構，既利用PLMs的預訓練序列演化知識，又利用MPLMs的預訓練結構知識，以迭代方式指導蛋白質序列生成。通過在標準蛋白質反向摺疊基準上的廣泛實驗，我們的方法達到了最先進的性能，超越了先前的方法，消融研究驗證了我們對稱設計的合理性，揭示了對社群來說一個有前景的方向。
